messages:
maria g: seeing weird duplicates in audit when routes are updated via our UI + API proxy. same change_id appears twice with different actor fields. not sure if it's coming from the frontend patch then the backend reconcile job
jon r: can you paste a couple of raw lines from the exported NDJSON? helps to see shape (PII scrubbed ok)
maria g: here (sanitized):
`\{"change_id\":\"chg_01F...\",\"resource\":\"route/rdw-123\",\"actor\":\{\"id\":\"user:alice\",\"source\":\"console\"\},\"ts\":1719876400}`
`\{"change_id\":\"chg_01F...\",\"resource\":\"route/rdw-123\",\"actor\":\{\"id\":\"service:route-sync\",\"source\":\"syncer\"\},\"ts\":1719876405}`
phil s: yup this is the reconcile pattern. console writes a change, then we emit a system-change when the reconcile job updates derived state. both are technically correct but users ask "who changed it?"
sara l: from UX perspective we need an attribution priority for the console view: prefer human actor if present in same change_id window, otherwise show service actor. also clearly surface when a system reconcile ran. show both in expanded details
kai: question: do we currently dedupe by change_id in exports? the export pipeline flattens events, we used `change_id` as a partition key but not a dedupe key
jon r: correct, export just streams everything. downstreams expect idempotent events so duplicates are a problem for some SIEMs. maybe add an `entry_kind` enum: human_action | system_reconcile | derived_update
compliance-bot: reminder: retention and export formats need to preserve unmodified audit fidelity for compliance. any transformation must be reversible or stored as a sidecar file
maria g: proposal: augment export lines with `canonical_actor` (id string), `actor_sources` (array of strings), and `primary_actor_hint` (human|system|unknown). no binary transform of actor: keep original actor blob
phil s: sounds good. also add `dedupe_window_ms` metadata when the change spans multiple rapid events. UI can use that to group and show "1 user change + 1 reconciler"
sara l: can we include minimal sample in the API docs? e.g.:
```
{
  "change_id":"chg_01F...",
  "resource":"route/rdw-123",
  "actors":[{"id":"user:alice","source":"console"},{"id":"service:route-sync","source":"syncer"}],
  "canonical_actor":"user:alice",
  "primary_actor_hint":"human",
  "ts_first":1719876400,
  "ts_last":1719876405
}
```
jon r: for telemetry + dashboards we should add `attribution_confidence` (low/med/high) computed by heuristics: same change_id && actor.type==user => high, only service actors => low
kai: that lets us power the sidebar filter: show only high-confidence human changes. reduces noise for auditors
phil s: implementation note: add a post-processor in the audit aggregator service that emits a merged event when it detects same `change_id` within X seconds. emit both original raw lines to the raw archive bucket (for compliance) and the merged line to the export topic
maria g: timeline? this would be a small change in aggregator + docs. can we do a canary for a single org first?
jon r: +1 on canary. I'll make a tiny feature flag `audit_merge_by_change_id` scoped to org and route it to one heavy-audit customer
compliance-bot: flagged for legal review if you plan to change exported shape for customers — include migration notes and opt-in behavior
sara l: I'll draft the console UX: collapsed row with "primary actor (human)" and an expandable area for system events. will attach mockups in next message
phil s: thanks all. ACTIONS: jon to prototype post-processor + flag, mari to update export schema proposal, sara to do mockups, kai to update telemetry scoring doc. aim for spike next week.
